system.prerequisites: Inner Discipline, Devoted or Illuminator Monastic Path
system.description:
DISCIPLE FOCUS MYSTIC STANCE TECHNIQUE

You learn an ancient stance that cloaks your movements in a shadowy spiritual presence. The stance lasts for 1 minute. Whilst in the stance, your attacks inflict essence damage and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to all Escape checks. When the stance ends, Shadowy Stance is expended until restored with Refocus.

Automated: press Use to enter the stance (the system's stance rules and AP) and spend this use. For 1 minute your Strikes may deal essence damage (chosen on each Strike, as Versatile is), and Escape checks get +2 circumstance.
